
{{alias}}( str )
    Parses a string as an unsigned 64-bit integer.

    Parameters
    ----------
    str: string
        String representation of a nonnegative integer.

    Returns
    -------
    v: Uint64
        Unsigned 64-bit integer.

    Examples
    --------
    > var x = {{alias}}( '1234' )
    <Uint64>
    > x.toString()
    '1234'


    See Also
    --------
